recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-22680; any future cqf-calculatedValue maintenance belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack, where the Expression type and later deprecation guidance are already applied.
issue_request: FHIR-22680 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core CDS change request to allow the cqf-calculatedValue extension to carry an Expression value instead of only a string, enabling inline FHIRPath as well as named library expressions.
initial_application: Core commit a24a2ffee0e8a76e7d91daea31529517a0d9d1da applied J#22680 by changing cqf-calculatedValue in source/profiles/clinicalreasoning-extensions-spreadsheet.xml from string to Expression. The calculatedValue row still used Expression immediately before core extension definitions were removed.
additional_context: FHIR core commit dd468d4f17 removed extension definitions from the R5 core source. Current core retains only the cqf-calculatedValue OID, while /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/Element/StructureDefinition-cqf-calculatedValue.xml is included by the Extension Pack and constrains Extension.value[x] to Expression. Later FHIR-51490 deprecated cqf-calculatedValue in favor of cqf-expression without changing that value type.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No FHIR-core source change was made because the current authoritative StructureDefinition is outside this checkout and already satisfies the issue.
